{{Short description|American beverage company}} {{Use mdy dates|date=January 2024}} {{Use American English|date=January 2024}} {{Infobox company | name = Olipop, Inc. | logo = Olipop, Inc. Logo.webp | logo_caption = | image = Olipop Strawberry Vanilla can.jpg | image_size = 150px | image_caption = A can of Olipop Strawberry Vanilla | industry = [[Beverage]] | hq_location = Oakland, California (USA) | founded = 2018 | type = Private | founders = Ben Goodwin
David Lester | revenue = {{Unbulleted list|{{Increase}} US$73.4 million (2022)}} | website = {{URL|drinkolipop.com}} }} '''Olipop''' (stylized as '''OLIPOP''') is a [[Prebiotic (nutrition)|prebiotic]] [[soft drink]] produced in the United States. It is sold in over 65,000 retailers nationwide{{Cite web |title=Where Can You Buy OLIPOP? How to Find OLIPOP in the Wild |url=https://drinkolipop.com/blogs/digest/where-to-buy-olipop |access-date=2026-03-04 |website=OLIPOP |language=en}} and the company is valued $1.85 billion as of February 2025.{{Cite web |last=Jackson |first=Ashton |date=2025-09-25 |title=Olipop CEO: If I had to start over in my career, I’d prioritize this skillset above all others—it’s not AI |url=https://www.cnbc.com/2025/09/25/olipop-ceo-if-i-had-to-start-over-in-my-career-id-prioritize-these-skills.html |access-date=2026-03-04 |website=CNBC |language=en}} The drink's marketing claims that it improves gut health.{{Cite news|title=Prebiotic sodas claim to boost your health. Experts are skeptical.|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/wellness/2023/04/03/prebiotic-soda-olipop-poppi/|access-date=26 December 2023|newspaper=[[The Washington Post]]|last1=Amenabar|first1=Teddy|last2=O'Connor|first2=Anahad|date=3 April 2023|archive-date=August 9, 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230809065911/https://www.washingtonpost.com/wellness/2023/04/03/prebiotic-soda-olipop-poppi/|url-status=live}} The brand name Olipop is a [[portmanteau]] of the [[Prebiotic (nutrition)|prebiotic]] fiber [[oligosaccharide]] (oli), and "pop", a common name for a soft drink in the United States.{{Cite web |last1=Smith |first1=Morgan |last2=Shamo |first2=Lauren |date=2023-09-16 |title=How Olipop's founders turned a $100,000 investment into a 'healthier' soda brand bringing in $20 million a month |url=https://www.cnbc.com/2023/09/16/how-olipops-founders-turned-100k-investment-into-healthier-soda-brand.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231122075642/https://www.cnbc.com/2023/09/16/how-olipops-founders-turned-100k-investment-into-healthier-soda-brand.html |archive-date=November 22, 2023 |access-date=2023-11-24 |website=CNBC |language=en}} == History == === Background === Ben Goodwin started developing a soft drink after leaving a [[kombucha]] company in 2008. He spent about $300,000 of his personal savings on the project, working in a makeshift lab with a microbiologist. The [[probiotic]] soft drink, named Obi, was created by 2012. In 2013, Goodwin met with David Lester in a coffee shop, who had previously quit his job. The two agreed to partner together in making Obi. In 2016, the two sold Obi for an undisclosed amount after it failed to gain traction.{{Cite web |title=Olipop's 38-year-old founder reveals his daily routine |url=https://fortune.com/well/article/olipop-cofounder-daily-habits-wellness-routine-ben-goodwin/ |access-date=2023-12-26 |website=Fortune Well |language=en |last1=Kirol |first1=Payton |date=December 18, 2023 |archive-date=December 26, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231226063318/https://fortune.com/well/article/olipop-cofounder-daily-habits-wellness-routine-ben-goodwin/ |url-status=live }} They then went on to work on Olipop. === Olipop === Olipop was founded in 2018 by Ben Goodwin and David Lester with an initial investment of $100,000, taken from the sale of Obi. The drink was first released in three flavors: ginger lemon, strawberry vanilla and cinnamon cola. It sold in 40 grocery stores in its first year, in Northern California, and reached $852,000 in gross revenue. They later became on sale in [[Target Corporation|Target]] and [[Walmart]] stores. The company gathered $2.5 million in seed funding in 2019. {{As of|2023|April}}, there were 12 Olipop flavors; in April 2024, there were 16 at Olipop's website. A series B funding round was carried out in 2022, which raised $39.7 million. Funders included [[Gwyneth Paltrow]], [[Mindy Kaling]], and the [[Jonas Brothers]]. {{As of|2023|January}}, Olipop raised a total of $55.4 million in funding.{{Cite web |last=Lucas |first=Amelia |date=2023-04-29 |title=Prebiotic soda Olipop approaches $200 million in annual sales — and CEO says Coca-Cola and PepsiCo have already come knocking |url=https://www.cnbc.com/2023/04/29/olipop-nears-200-million-in-annual-sales-coke-pepsi-come-knocking-ceo-says.html |access-date=2024-01-03 |website=CNBC |language=en |archive-date=January 3, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240103072014/https://www.cnbc.com/2023/04/29/olipop-nears-200-million-in-annual-sales-coke-pepsi-come-knocking-ceo-says.html |url-status=live }} Olipop reached $73.4 million in gross revenue in 2022, a 223% year increase;{{Cite web |last=Kilmister |first=Angel |date=2023-03-08 |title=OLIPOP's Prebiotic Root Beer Is Now More Popular Than A&W |url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/pkaeqb/olipop-root-beer |access-date=2024-01-03 |website=Vice |language=en |archive-date=January 3, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240103072735/https://www.vice.com/en/article/pkaeqb/olipop-root-beer |url-status=dead }} and it reached $100 million gross revenue in the first half of 2023. According to Goodwin, sales of root beer Olipop has overtaken those of [[A&W Root Beer|A&W]]. In 2022, Olipop created a banana cream flavor which was branded with [[Minions (Despicable Me)|Minions]] characters.{{Cite web |date=2022-06-07 |title=OLIPOP Announces Partnership With Illumination's Minions; Launches Limited-Edition Banana Cream Flavor |url=https://www.bevnet.com/news/2022/olipop-announces-partnership-with-illuminations-minions-launches-limited-edition-banana-cream-flavor/ |access-date=2025-02-15 |website=BevNET.com |language=en-US}} The drink is still produced today, albeit without the Minion or ''[[Despicable Me]]'' branding attached to it. In 2024, Olipop collaborated with [[Mattel]] to create a new peaches and cream flavor themed around [[Barbie]]. The can sported a design showing different pieces of Barbie iconography. Like the banana cream flavor before it, after the promotion it became a mainstay flavor without the Barbie theming. In 2025, the company raised $50 million in a [[Series C]] funding round, valuing the company at $1.85 billion. It had become profitable and its products were sold in over 50,000 stores.{{Cite news |last=Shanker |first=Deena |date=February 12, 2025 |title=Olipop Valued at $1.85 Billion in $50 Million Funding Round |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-02-12/olipop-valued-at-1-85-billion-in-50-million-funding-round |access-date=2025-02-15 |work=Bloomberg}} In 2025, Olipop released the soda flavor Pineapple Paradise in cross-marketing with [[The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants]]; the cans displayed the character [[SpongeBob SquarePants]] as seen in the movie.[https://drinkolipop.com/products/spongebob-pineapple-paradise SpongeBob Pineapple Paradise] In 2026, [[Grüns]] partnered with Olipop on a limited-edition release of Strawberry Vanilla Superfoods Greens Gummies.{{cite news |last1=Ostertag |first1=Elizabeth |title=Gruns and Olipop Team Up on Limited-Edition Strawberry Vanilla Greens Gummies |url=https://athletechnews.com/gruns-and-olipop-team-up-on-limited-edition-strawberry-vanilla-greens-gummies/ |work=Athletech News |date=April 22, 2026}} In 2026, Olipop released lip balm themed and flavored around their various flavors.{{Cite web |date=February 17, 2026 |title=flavored ceramide lip blur balm |url=https://www.cocokind.com/products/olipop-flavored-ceramide-lip-blur-balm |url-status=live |access-date=June 17, 2026 |website=cocokind}} == Operations == {{As of|2025|August}}, Olipop has approximately 373 employees.{{Cite web |title=OLIPOP PBC Employee Directory, Headcount & Staff {{!}} LeadIQ |url=https://leadiq.com/c/olipop-pbc/5d13d2001f00003b01b4f099/employee-directory |access-date=2025-09-23 |website=leadiq.com |language=en}} The workforce is [[Remote work|remote]]. Olipop offers a subscription which sends customers a box of drinks every few weeks.{{Cite web |last3=Brains |first3=James |first1=Remi |last1=Rosmarin |first2=Connie |last2=Chen |title=The 57 best subscription boxes you can gift in 2023 |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/guides/gifts/subscription-gifts |access-date=2024-01-03 |website=Business Insider |language=en-US |date=December 13, 2023 |archive-date=January 3, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240103071734/https://www.businessinsider.com/guides/gifts/subscription-gifts |url-status=live }} Olipop is currently only available in the United States and in a limited capacity in Canada. Potential markets include Asia and Australia. ==Flavors== Olipop has developed a variety of flavors:{{div col|colwidth=12em}} *Citrus Rush (Lemon-Lime-Orange) (formerly Ridge Rush) *Vintage Cola *Peaches & Cream *Classic Root Beer *Cream Soda *Classic Grape *Crisp Apple *Ginger Ale *Strawberry Vanilla *Cherry Cola *Orange Squeeze *Lemon Lime *Ginger Lemon *Doctor Goodwin *Watermelon Lime *Banana Cream *Cherry Vanilla *Tropical Punch *Orange Cream *Pineapple Paradise *Shirley Temple *Blackberry Vanilla *Raspberry Sherbet{{div col end}}Its drinks require refrigeration. Olipop introduced shelf-stable versions of its product in 2024.{{Cite web |title=A Message From Our CEO: Introducing New Shelf-Stable OLIPOP |url=https://drinkolipop.com/blogs/digest/introducing-new-shelf-stable-olipop |access-date=2025-02-15 |website=OLIPOP |language=en}} This shelf-stable line features a revised version of the company’s “proprietary” OLISMART fiber mix, replacing Chicory Root Inulin and Jerusalem Artichoke Inulin with Acacia Fiber and Guar Fiber for a roughly 30% reduction in fiber.{{Cite web |title=What Is OLISMART? Get To Know the Ingredients in OLIPOP |url=https://drinkolipop.com/blogs/digest/what-is-olismart-get-to-know-the-ingredients-in-olipop |access-date=2025-10-06 |website=OLIPOP |language=en}} == See also == * [[Poppi (drink)|Poppi]], a competing brand of prebiotic soda * [[Slice (drink)|Slice]], another competing brand of prebiotic soda == References == {{Reflist}} {{Colas}} [[Category:Drink companies]] [[Category:American companies established in 2018]] [[Category:American soft drinks]] [[Category:B Lab-certified corporations]] [[Category:Food and drink companies established in 2018]]
extract:
Olipop (stylized as OLIPOP) is a prebiotic soft drink produced in the United States. It is sold in over 65,000 retailers nationwide and the company is valued $1.85 billion as of February 2025. The drink's marketing claims that it improves gut health.
The brand name Olipop is a portmanteau of the prebiotic fiber oligosaccharide (oli), and "pop", a common name for a soft drink in the United States.
